title: Infra Wiki
description: Dummy internal wiki with two step-by-step SOP pages for typical infrastructure operations: renew a TLS certificate and patch and restart a VM. The SOPs in Infrastructure Operations point to these steps.
insights: Fictional internal pages: each SOP lists purpose, scope, roles, what to check before, ten steps with who does it, with which tool, when it is done and what to do if it fails, then rollback and evidence.

The steps map one to one to the orchestration of Infrastructure Operations (trigger, ticket, pre-check, approval, window, run, verification, evidence), so the SOP can run end to end in n8n and AWX (simulated).
Joule reads the same pages through the connector tool read_wiki_page; the Space has no network of its own.
prompt: Bundled example: Infra Wiki (static, pages embedded by npm run sync:infra-wiki).
